programme.title: Aizraujošie vilcienu maršruti
programme.desc: Šajā sērijā Maikls Portillo viesosies Francijā. Savu ceļojumu viņš sāks Orleānā, kur uzzinās vairāk par Francijas nacionālās varones Žannas d'Arkas dzīvi un pāragro nāvi. Tālāk ceļš viņu aizvedīs uz kādu pili, kam bija nozīmīga loma Lielbritānijas karaliskajā vēsturē. Nākamā pietura Maikla ceļojumā būs Lemāna, kur viņš ķers asas izjūtas sacīkšu trasē. Pēc tam viņš dosies uz Versaļu un noskaidros, kā Versaļas līgums ietekmēja Ādolfa Hitlera un nacistu nākšanu pie varas. Piedzīvojums turpināsies Eiropas mākslas pilsētā Parīzē, kur Maikls paviesosies kādā kabarē un uzdejos banānu svārciņos. Pēdējā pietura būs Reimsa un "Pommery" šampanieša ražotne ar iespaidīgām pazemes ejām, kas kara laikā kalpoja kā patvērums vietējiem iedzīvotājiem.

programme.title: Province
programme.desc: "Province" – tie ir valsts bēniņi. Tā ir kā savdabīga pasaule, kam ikdienā mēs, viesistabu un guļamistabu apdzīvotāji, nepievēršam daudz uzmanības. Laiks šeit rit pēc citiem likumiem. Tas atnāk gandrīz tikpat ātri, bet aiziet lēnāk un ilgāk kavējas. Katrai valstij un tautai ir vajadzīgi savi bēniņi. Tie dod kādu īpašu stabilitāti, kas nekā citādi nav iegūstama. Bēniņu lielākā bagātība ir to spēja būt citādiem…

programme.title: Adreses
programme.desc: Arhitektūra no visām kultūras jomām ir cilvēkiem vistuvākā – tā ir visapkārt un nemanāmi, bet pamatīgi ietekmē cilvēku ikdienu, domāšanu, gaumi. Arhitektūra ir sabiedrības kopējā dzīves telpa. Adreses ar parastu cilvēku acīm pēta veiksmīgus un ne tik veiksmīgus vai pat kliedzošus arhitektūras un vides veidošanas piemērus. Katru nedēļu raidījuma autors Mārtiņš Ķibilds dodas uz divām vietām jeb adresēm, līdzi ņemot katrreiz citu cilvēku – bez profesionālas pieredzes arhitektūrā, toties ar urdošu vēlmi izzināt, domāt līdzi un dalīties iespaidos ar skatītājiem.

programme.title: Mērdoka noslēpumi
programme.desc: Brekenrīda kundze sarīko kārtējo skandālu saistībā ar vīra dzeršanu. Pat pasaka, lai labāk viņš mājās nenāk. Upes malā atrod Veronikas Viljamsas līķi. Lai gan viņai pārgrieztas vēnas uz plaukstas locītavām, Mērdoks ir pārliecināts, ka tā nav pašnāvība. Tā kā nogalinātā strādāja telegrāfā, viņš lūdz Īnidas palīdzību. Tikmēr iecirknī visus sāk uztraukt Brekenrīda neizprotamā uzvedība.

programme.title: Krustpunktā
programme.desc: Visvairāk klausītais Latvijas radio raidījums "Krustpunktā" redzams arī Latvijas televīzijas ēterā. Ne tiešraidē, bet ar nelielu nobīdi, iespējams sekot līdzi gan aktuālajām intervijām, gan klausītāju uzdotajiem jautājumiem un amatpersonu atbildēm.

programme.title: Sisi
programme.desc: Emanuela nolemj sazināties ar ungāru nemiernieku vadoni Ēdenu Kerteku. Kerteks nolaupa Sisi un Andrāši un aizved tos dziļi mežā cerībā, ka ķeizars Francis nevarēs gūstekņus atrast. Gūsts un mocības vēl vairāk satuvina Sisi un Andrāši. Vienīgā, kura vēl var glābt Sisi, ir viņas uzticamā kalpone grāfiene Esterhāzī. Tikmēr Francis ir neziņā par sievas likteni un kopā ar Mariju dodas pie Sisi vecākiem uz Posenhofenu, lai lūgtu Bavārijas karaļa Ludviga atbalstu gaidāmajā karā ar Bismarku. Posenhofenā Francis satiek Sisi māsu Helēnu un uzzina, ka Helēnai aizvien ir jūtas pret Franci.

programme.title: Sisi
programme.desc: Seriāla otrā daļa galveno uzmanību pievērš cīņām par varu Eiropā: Bismarks draud iedzīt Austriju jaunā karā. Sisi ar visiem spēkiem cenšas atbalstīt savu vīru Franci Jozefu un glābt valsti no kara. Lai arī viņa mīl Franci no visas sirds un atkārtoti apliecina savu uzticību un diplomātisko talantu, šķiet, ka ķeizarienei netiek ļauts izbaudīt personīgo laimi ģimenes lokā. Sisi dodas uz Ungāriju meklēt sabiedrotos draudošajam karam ar Bismarku, kur apstākļi saved viņu kopā ar ungāru grāfu Andrāši.

programme.title: Sirdslietas. Senioru iepazīšanās šovs
programme.desc: Iepazīšanas šovā "Sirdslietas" seniori turpina apmeklēt ātros randiņus. Viņiem ir dotas 15 minūtes, lai gūtu pirmos iespaidus un lemtu, vai draudzībai sekos turpinājums. Šajā sērijā skatīsimies, kā ar pirmās tikšanās mulsumu tiks galā bijušais bārmenis Gunārs, enerģiskā Baiba, šarmantā Ināra no Valdlaučiem, bijušais ierēdnis Andis, būvinženieris Viesturs, kuram šis būs jau otrais randiņš, un rīdziniece Ināra, kura lielu daļu savas profesionālās dzīves aizvadījusi militārajos formastērpos.

programme.title: Pa straumei
programme.desc: Divi bērnības draugi – Helēna un Roberts – nolēma piekrist aizraujošam izaicinājumam un iepazīt Latvijas upes – upju stāstus, to krastus, cilvēkus, vietas, dabu un vēsturi. Lai būtu pavisam jautri, kopā ar draugiem devās ziņkārīgā sunene Urga. Viņa ir dzīvespriecīga, brīvdabas aktivitātes mīloša sunene, kurai patīk gulēt teltī, peldēt un sildīties pie ugunskura. Draudzīgā trijotne izceļos Latvijas upes.

programme.title: Rīta Panorāma
programme.desc: Enerģisks un iedvesmojošs sākums jaunai dienai! Ieskats gaidāmās dienas notikumos Latvijā un pasaulē, kultūras, izklaides un sporta ziņas, laika prognoze. Arī atskats uz aizvadītās dienas notikumiem, pievēršot uzmanību to attīstībai nakts laikā. Aizrautīgas sarunas ar viesiem un skanīgi muzikālie priekšnesumi. Raidījumu vada Gusts Kikusts, Sigurds Siliņš, Karīna Rubene, Danuta Juste, sporta ziņas lasa Reinis Ošenieks, Raimonds Gekišs, laika ziņas – Ilze Skudra, Ilze Golubeva, Toms Bricis.

programme.title: Skaņusaite
programme.desc: "Skaņusaite" "Kokles" epizodē Helsinku pavasara plaukumā tiekas ar Paivi Hirvonenu – somu mākslinieci, kuras balss skanējums, šķiet, modina visas senču tradīcijas un spēku. Pazīstama kā viena no labākajām vienlaicīgas vijoles spēles un dziedāšanas meistarēm, Paivi dalās savos mūzikas pieredzes līkločos. Turpat Somijas galvaspilsētā iepazīstamies arī ar roķīguma un jaudas pilno grupu "Okra Playground', un mūziķi atklāj, kā vienlaikus būt uzticīgiem savām tradīcijām un saknēm, ļaujot mūsdienīgam skanējumam iekrāsot katru radīto darbu. Personīgajā ierakstu studijā tiekamies ar "Vienas sievietes orķestri" – Maiju Kauhanenu. Starp nepārredzamām kokļu kupenām un ritma instrumentu avantūrām – katliem, krūzītēm un citiem virtuves piederumiem – slēpjas Maija, mākslinieciska razbainieciskuma pilna māksliniece, kas epizodes turpinājumā savās dzimtajās mājās mūs iepazīstina ar saviem vecākiem, bet viņi – ar viesmīlīgiem stāstiem par Maiju un to, kā tētis izgatavojis pirmo mākslinieces kokli. Raidījums turpinās Igaunijā, kur tiekamies ar mūsu ziemeļu kaimiņu vārda tik lieliskajām daudzinātājām "Duo Ruut". Neviltoti saistošā sarunā mūziķes mūs iepazīstina ar savām takām, mūzikas karjeru kaldinot. Noslēgumā dabas varenību un spēku smeļamies Rummu karjerā, kas bija lielisks "Skaņusaites" vērtību rezonators.

programme.title: Pasaules maratonists
programme.desc: Šoreiz Rauls Gomess dosies uz Meksiku. Lai arī tur runā spāņu valodā, neiztiks bez dažiem pārpratumiem, īpaši sieviešu kompānijā. Šoreiz Rauls sagatavojis supervaroņu stāstus. Mehiko pusmaratonā piedalās 25000 skrējēju. Viņu vidū ir arī skrējēji ar redzes traucējumiem. Un naktsmājas pasaules maratonists ir atradis pie kādas aktieru ģimenes. Krāsainā un kontrastu pilnā zeme patīkami pārsteigs Raulu.

programme.title: Vides fakti
programme.desc: Raidījums par norisēm dabā un apkārtējā vidē. "Vides fakti" sniedz informāciju par sezonālām norisēm dabā un dzīvnieku pasaulē, par vides aktualitātēm, par videi draudzīgu dzīvesveidu, par aktuālām cilvēka un vides attiecībām ārpus Latvijas robežām. Raidījumā "Vides fakti" ir skatāmi arī piedzīvojumu sižeti par aktīvā tūrisma iespējām Latvijā, kā arī īsfilmas par neparastiem ceļojumiem pasaulē.

programme.title: Hadsons un Reksis
programme.desc: Inspektors Reksis ir atgriezies! Tikai citā ampluā. Uz populārā austriešu detektīvseriāla motīviem balstītais kanādiešu seriāls būs stāsts par draudzību, cieņu un noziegumiem. Detektīvs Čārlzs Hadsons ir galvenais detektīvs Svētā Džona policijas iecirknī. Viņa partneris ir Reksis, vācu aitas šķirnes suns ar izcilu dzirdi. Hadsons jau kopš bērnības ir vēlējies kļūt par detektīvu. Reksi izglāba nejaušība. Viņu vēlējās iemidzināt pēc tam, kad viņa iepriekšējais "cilvēkpartneris" gāja bojā dienesta laikā. Tomēr Rekša palīdzība ikdienas darbā ir nenovērtējama. Detektīvu komandā darbojas arī superintendants Donovans un IT speciālists Mills. Jaunajā darbā Hadsons nokļuva pēc šķiršanās ar sievu, un visas sezonas gaitā viņu un partneri Reksi sagaida mīklainas slepkavības un, protams... pica un hotdogi. Reksis spēj saost picas piegādātāju pat kilometriem tālu! Galvenās lomas atveidotājs ir kanādiešu aktieris Džons Rīrdons, kurš ir zināms arī kā veiksmīgs futbolists. Jaunībā aktieris vēlējies karjeru medicīnā un ieguvis bakalaura grādu bioloģijā. Filmēties sācis 2000. gadu sākumā, un ir pazīstams arī ar lomu tīņu trillerī "Šausmenīte 4".

programme.title: Alpu dakteris
programme.desc: Nav labākas vietas, kur patverties no pilsētas kņadas, trokšņa un stresa, kā kalni. Bet dzīvot tur? Dzimto Alpu mazpilsētiņu, saucot tās gaisotni par smacējošu un aprobežotu, Mārtins pameta jau pirms daudziem gadiem, lai kļūtu par veiksmīgu ārstu kosmopolītiskajā lielpilsētā Ņujorkā. Nu viņš ir atgriezies. Uz pavisam īsu apciemojumu, lai atkal drīz atvadītos. Taču no likteņa neizbēgsi - atgriešanās mājās izrādās uz palikšanu. Jo pārāk liels ir trieciens, uzzinot, ka viņa pirmā mīlestība, kas pēc Mārtina aizbraukšanas apprecēja viņa paša brāli Hansu, ir mirusi. Taču atstājusi meitu, par kuras esamību Mārtins nekad pat nebija zinājis! Ar to izrādās pietiekami, lai izlemtu palikt Pēkšņi kļuvis par tēvu, Mārtins vēlas uzzināt vairāk par savu jauniegūto meitu Lili, iemantot viņas uzticēšanos. Tā dēļ viņš ir gatavs pat mēģināt sadarboties ar savu jaunāko brāli Hansu, kas joprojām jūt aizvainojumu. Hanss ir kļuvis par glābēju komandas vadītāju, un kopā ar Mārtinu viņi turpmāk neskaitāmas reizes riskēs ar savu dzīvību, lai glābtu kalnu negadījumu upurus vai kāpējus, ko pārsteigusi pēkšņa vētra. Mārtinu gaida atklāsme, ka bez saknēm nav iespējas turpināt dzīvi. Šeit viņš pilnībā aptvers arī to, ka būt par ārstu kalnos - tā nav tikai profesija, bet gan aicinājums. Kļūt par labu neatliekamās medicīniskās palīdzības sniedzēju kalnos iemācīties nevar, par tādu piedzimst. Un Mārtins Grūbers tāds neapšaubāmi ir!

programme.title: Aizraujošie vilcienu maršruti
programme.desc: Maikls Portillo dosies uz tēva dzimto zemi Spāniju, un gan viņš pats, gan skatītāji uzzinās ko vairāk par tās pilsoņu karu. Iepazīsim gan Salamankas Universitāti, kur dzirdēsim stāstu par Maikla vecāku tikšanos, gan vienu no Pablo Pikaso pazīstamākajām gleznām, kas veltīta Gernikas bombardēšanai. Tiksimies ar Džordža Orvela dēlu vietā, kur viņa tēvs pilsoņu karā cīnījās ierakumos, kā arī apciemosim satriecošo Kanfrankas staciju pie Francijas robežas, kas drīz atkal varētu savienot Spāniju ar pārējo Eiropu.

programme.title: Nepabeigta saruna par dzīvi, mīlestību un mūziku
programme.desc: Filmas centrā – komponists Ādolfs Skulte (1909–2000) un viņa dzīvesstāsts paša atmiņās, arhīvu materiālos un mūzikā. 90. gadu beigās filmētās intervijās meistars stāsta savu dzīvi un atceras bērnību, studiju laiku pie profesora Jāzepa Vītola, pedagoga darbību un spilgtākos studentus – Imantu Kalniņu, Mārtiņu Braunu, Vilni Šmīdbergu un citus –, baleta "Brīvības sakta" tapšanu (1946–1950) un citus svarīgus savas dzīves notikumus, kuru rezumējums ir 1999. gadā saņemtā Lielā mūzikas balva par mūža ieguldījumu. Ādolfu Skulti filmē viņa dēls, kinooperators Gvido Skulte, filmā svarīgu vietu ieņem arī komponista dzīvesbiedre Helēna un mazdēls, mākslinieks Kristaps Skulte.

programme.title: Komisārs Reksis
programme.desc: Miterers lēnām iemācās sadzīvot ar Reksi. Nolaupītā zēna vectēvs tiek atrasts miris, noziegums ir inscenēts kā pašnāvība. Izmeklētāji prāto, vai tam ir saistība ar zēna pazušanu vai ko citu. Inspektors Nero ir atjaunots amatā, tomēr Miterers viņam neuzticas. Mirušā viesnīcnieka datorā izmeklētāji atrod aizdomīgu videoklipu, kurā redzama meitene, kas pirms gada izdarījusi pašnāvību. Dzenoties pakaļ aizdomās turētai personai, Reksis tiek smagi savainots. Miterers cer, ka Reksis izķepurosies. Rodas aizdomas par to, ka noziegumā varētu būt iesaistīts kāds policists. Vai Miterers spēs atklāt patiesību?

programme.title: Zinātnes noslēpumi
programme.desc: Dažādas mūsu ikdienā ierastas darbības un notikumi, izskaidroti no zinātnes viedokļa.

programme.title: Pasaules maratonists
programme.desc: Rauls dosies uz Itāliju, kur norisinās "Corsa del Barroco" skrējiens cauri trim pilsētiņām. Arī šoreiz Raulam padomā dažādu cilvēku dzīvesstāsti. Sicīlija nav tālu no Āfrikas, un dažiem ir izdevies veiksmīgi šķērsot Vidusjūru, lai sāktu jaunu dzīvi. Naktsmājas šoreiz nodrošina kāds filozofu pāris, un Rauls būs pārsteigts par gultasvietu. Pasaules maratonists atradīs interesantu veidu, kā uzlabot savas itāļu valodas zināšanas.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Briērs sagatavo rakstu par Bokasini. Lorāns izdara spiedienu uz iecirkņa komandu saistībā ar dimantu lietu. Korbēna nolēmusi atzīties vīra slepkavībā. Iecirknī ierodas rakstniece Lea Bordāža, kura satraukusies par viņai veltītajiem nāves draudiem.

programme.title: Broukenvuda
programme.desc: Broukenvuda ir parasts nomaļš ciemats – tādā var iemaldīties, braucot no jebkuras lielpilsētas. Cilvēki te ir jauki, komunikabli un savā starpā pazīstami. Ciematā ir golfa klubs un vīna degustēšanas pasākumi. Viss, kas ciematam piederas… arī seni noslēpumi, meli un slepkavības. Inspektors Maiks Šeperds un viņa partnere Kristīna Simsa ir atbildīgi par mieru pilsētā. Viņi izmeklē mistiskās, atjautīgās un nežēlīgās slepkavības. Seriāls ieguvis "TV Drāmas bronzas godalgu" Ņujorkas starptautiskajā filmu un televīzijas festivālā.

programme.title: Makdonalda un Dodss
programme.desc: Bātā ir sākusies kāzu sezona. Lotijas un Billija kāzu laikā tiek nogalināts mācītājs Mičels Morisons. Līgava Florensa Sondersa tiek noindēta mielasta laikā. Kad notiek slepkavība vēl trešajās kāzās, Makdonaldai un Dodsam sākas īstākā skriešanās ar laiku, lai atrastu slepkavu un nepieļautu jaunas traģēdijas.

programme.title: Eiropa fokusā
programme.desc: "Deutsche Welle" žurnāls stāsta par cilvēku dzīvi Eiropā, viņu cerībām un bailēm, sniedz plašu pārskatu pār tautu, kultūru un ainavu daudzveidību tajā.

programme.title: Ielas garumā
programme.desc: Zasulauka stacijas apkaimē satiekas Āgenskalns, Zasulauks un Šampēteris, un šajā daudzveidīgajā vidē esam uzklausījuši aizraujošus stāstus. Dažus no tiem atgādināsim – kaut vai par Fabrikantu ielas pārtapšanu Darba ielā. Kas rajonā izmainījies pa šiem gadiem un kādas pārmaiņas sagaidāmas tuvākajā nākotnē, kad sāksies Rail Baltic dzelzceļa līnijas izbūve? Kā to uztver apkaimes iedzīvotāji, kuri rūpējas par dzīves kvalitāti? Būs arī jauni atklājumi Āgenskalna un Zasulauka robežielā – Kuldīgas ielā.

programme.title: Ielas garumā
programme.desc: Tavas apkārtnes stāsti.

programme.title: Kino diena. Kinodokumentālisti Ivars un Maija Selecki
programme.desc: 2014. gadā augstāko apbalvojumu Latvijas kino — "Lielo Kristapu" — par mūža ieguldījumu saņēma kino dokumentālisti Maija un Ivars Selecki. Ivars Seleckis, kurš toruden atzīmēja arī savu 80 gadu jubileju, ir vienīgais latviešu režisors, kurš saņēmis visas trīs pasaulē nozīmīgākās kino balvas — Eiropas Kinoakadēmijas "Fēliksu", Jorisa Īvensa un Roberta Flaerti balvu, kā arī vairākas "Lielā Kristapa" statuetes. Viņš filmējis Raimondu Paulu un Kurzemes zvejniekus, Elīnu Garanču un Latvijas zemniekus, Valmieras meitenes un Gvinejas iedzimtos. Viņa dokumentālo filmu "Šķērsiela", šķiet, noskatījies katrs latvietis. "Seleckis ir izcilākais Latvijas antroplogs," par viņu saka kino zinātnieks Agris Redovičs. Visas viņa filmas tapušas tandēmā ar montāžas režisori Maiju Selecku. "Kino diena" ir tikšanās ar abiem dokumentālistiem "viena kino seansa garumā", caurskatot abu kopīgi veidotās filmas un cenšoties noformulēt Rīgas dokumentālā kino skolas fenomenu un dokumentālista profesijas vārdos grūti izsakāmo būtību. Starp citu, kino dzimšanas diena — 28. decembris — ir arī Ivara un Maijas kāzu diena.

programme.title: V.I.P. - Veiksme. Intuīcija. Prāts
programme.desc: Kļūsti par TV spēles V.I.P. — Veiksme. Intuīcija. Prāts. — satura veidotāju, iesniedzot savu jautājumu. Vēlamies vairāk iesaistīt skatītājus, vairot interesi par erudīciju, lai skatītāji paši kļūtu par aizraujošu, interesantu jautājumu veidotājiem. Kas jādara? Aizpildi jautājumu anketu V.I.P. sadaļā un iegūsti vērtīgas grāmatas vai naudas balvu!

programme.title: Rīta Panorāma
programme.desc: Enerģisks un iedvesmojošs sākums jaunai dienai! Ieskats gaidāmās dienas notikumos Latvijā un pasaulē, kultūras, izklaides un sporta ziņas, laika prognoze. Arī atskats uz aizvadītās dienas notikumiem, pievēršot uzmanību to attīstībai nakts laikā. Aizrautīgas sarunas ar viesiem un skanīgi muzikālie priekšnesumi. Raidījumu vada Gusts Kikusts, Sigurds Siliņš, Karīna Rubene, Danuta Juste, sporta ziņas lasa Reinis Ošenieks, Raimonds Gekišs, laika ziņas – Ilze Skudra, Ilze Golubeva, Toms Bricis.

programme.title: Literatūre
programme.desc: "Literatūre" ir literārā tūrisma dokumentāls raidījumu cikls, kas apskata latviešu literatūru no sendienām līdz mūsdienām. Katrā epizodē kāds latviešu rakstnieks kā ceļa karti ņem kādu sev tuva aizgājušo laiku autora grāmatu un kopā ar literatūristi Martu dodas ceļojumā uz vietām, kur tas dzīvojis vai par kurām rakstījis. Savukārt, viņu savrupais ceļabiedrs Gustavs ceļo atsevišķi ar grāmatām un meklē, kam palasīt priekšā.

programme.title: Vides fakti
programme.desc: Raidījums par norisēm dabā un apkārtējā vidē. "Vides fakti" sniedz informāciju par sezonālām norisēm dabā un dzīvnieku pasaulē, par vides aktualitātēm, par videi draudzīgu dzīvesveidu, par aktuālām cilvēka un vides attiecībām ārpus Latvijas robežām. Raidījumā "Vides fakti" ir skatāmi arī piedzīvojumu sižeti par aktīvā tūrisma iespējām Latvijā, kā arī īsfilmas par neparastiem ceļojumiem pasaulē.

programme.title: Aizraujošie vilcienu maršruti
programme.desc: Šajā sērijā Maikls Portillo viesosies Francijā. Savu ceļojumu viņš sāks Orleānā, kur uzzinās vairāk par Francijas nacionālās varones Žannas d'Arkas dzīvi un pāragro nāvi. Tālāk ceļš viņu aizvedīs uz kādu pili, kam bija nozīmīga loma Lielbritānijas karaliskajā vēsturē. Nākamā pietura Maikla ceļojumā būs Lemāna, kur viņš ķers asas izjūtas sacīkšu trasē. Pēc tam viņš dosies uz Versaļu un noskaidros, kā Versaļas līgums ietekmēja Ādolfa Hitlera un nacistu nākšanu pie varas. Piedzīvojums turpināsies Eiropas mākslas pilsētā Parīzē, kur Maikls paviesosies kādā kabarē un uzdejos banānu svārciņos. Pēdējā pietura būs Reimsa un "Pommery" šampanieša ražotne ar iespaidīgām pazemes ejām, kas kara laikā kalpoja kā patvērums vietējiem iedzīvotājiem.

programme.title: Alana Tičmārša dārznieku klubiņš
programme.desc: Alans Tičmāršs un viņa dārznieku klubiņa komanda dalās idejās un iedvesmā ar visu līmeņu dārzniekiem. Erols Rūbens Fernandess apmeklē kopienas projektu Hārtfordšīrā, Kamila Baseta-Smita apskata drosmīgi veidotu rokoko stila dārzu Glosteršīrā, Hjū Ričardss atgriežas ar videi draudzīgiem padomiem par permakultūru, savukārt Klēra Lorija atkal atver savu telpaugu dienasgrāmatu, lai pastāstītu, kā labāk palīdzēt augiem pielāgoties jauniem apstākļiem.

programme.title: Nāve paradīzē
programme.desc: Kādā Karību jūras salā tiek atrasts nošauts britu policists Čārlijs. Nāves apstākļi ir neizprotami, jo līķis atrasts drošajā istabā, kur cilvēks pats ieslēdzas uzbrukuma gadījumā un ko var atvērt no ārpuses tikai policijas pārstāvis. Lai izmeklētu slepkavību, no Anglijas ierodas inspektors Ričards Pūls.

programme.title: Pasaules maratonists
programme.desc: Šoreiz Rauls startē gandrīz vai mājās. Skrējiens "Ultrapireneji" notiek Pireneju kalnos Katalonijā. Tā 45 kilometri ved pa kalnu takām 2400 metru augstumā un tad atkal atpakaļ lejā uz ciemu. Dalībniekiem nāksies skriet, soļot un rāpties pa akmeņiem, dubļiem un saknēm. Rauls iepazīsies ar divu bērnu māmiņu Lauru, kuru šis sports uzlādē, un Joanu, kurš nolēmis turpināt skriešanu par spīti osteoporozei.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Seriāls "Policijas iecirknis 31" seko stāstam par detektīvseržanti Nadīnu Legrānu un viņas kolēģi Patriku Bisonē, kā arī citiem viņu biedriem policijas iecirknī, kur viņi sastopas ar ikdienas noziegumiem, kas notiek lielajās pilsētās: slepkavības, nolaupīšanas, ielaušanās, vardarbība ģimenē, narkotiku tirdzniecība, terorisms un daudz kas cits.

programme.title: Broukenvuda
programme.desc: Broukenvuda ir parasts nomaļš ciemats – tādā var iemaldīties, braucot no jebkuras lielpilsētas. Cilvēki te ir jauki, komunikabli un savā starpā pazīstami. Ciematā ir golfa klubs un vīna degustēšanas pasākumi. Viss, kas ciematam piederas… arī seni noslēpumi, meli un slepkavības. Inspektors Maiks Šeperds un viņa partnere Kristīna Simsa ir atbildīgi par mieru pilsētā. Viņi izmeklē mistiskās, atjautīgās un nežēlīgās slepkavības. Seriāls ieguvis "TV Drāmas bronzas godalgu" Ņujorkas starptautiskajā filmu un televīzijas festivālā.

programme.title: Nelūgtie viesi
programme.desc: Izmeklētāji Ričards un Oskars saņem informāciju par jaunu slepkavību Kandavā. Oskars piedalās kino uzņemšanā. Pie Oskara ierodas negaidīts ciemiņš.

programme.title: Nelūgtie viesi
programme.desc: Oskara dzimšanas dienas svinības izvēršas ne tā, kā bija ieplānots. Mazpilsētā atkal notiek slepkavība.

programme.title: Teātra garša
programme.desc: Divi spilgti un skatītāju iemīļoti aktieri, kuri savulaik izvēlējās aiziet no repertuārteātra, lai paliktu tuvāk sev, - Dārta Daneviča un Dainis Grūbe. Viņus vieno ne tikai profesionāli panākumi un skatītāju atzinība, bet arī drosme izvēlēties brīvību laikā, kad šķita, ka sasniegts tas, pēc kā daudzi tiecas visu mūžu. Atklātā sarunā viņi runā par izdegšanu, iekšējām cīņām, nepieciešamību apstāties un uzdot sev neērtus jautājumus. Par to, cik sarežģīti ir vienlaikus būt māksliniekam, vecākam un cilvēkam, kurš cenšas nepazaudēt sevi nepārtrauktajā skrējienā. Par cenu, ko reizēm nākas maksāt par panākumiem, un par drosmi mainīt dzīvi, kad ārēji viss šķiet kārtībā. Viņus vieno arī laba kafija un īsta draudzība - tāda, kurā nav nepieciešams satikties bieži, lai saruna uzreiz kļūtu dziļa, patiesa un dziedinoša. Saruna par dzīvi ārpus lomām un par drosmi būt tam, kas esi patiesībā.

programme.title: Gintas Krievkalnas solokoncerts Nakts lūgums
programme.desc: Dziedātājas Gintas Krievkalnas (Ēķes) pirmais solokoncerts "Nakts lūgums" ar komponistu Zigmaru Liepiņu.

programme.title: Sajūti Latgali
programme.desc: "Sajūti Latgali" veidotāji piedāvā iespēju iepazīt Latgali tuvāk un sajust tās burvību. Ar stāstiem par uzņēmīgiem un interesantiem cilvēkiem tiks lauzti stereotipi par Latgali kā mazattīstītu reģionu. Raidījumos tiks stāstīts par latgaliešu valodu, Latgales vēstniecību "Gors", folkloras kopu "Svātra", jauniešu aktivitātēm Rēzeknes un Ciblas novados, kā arī Daugavpilī. Būs stāsti arī par katoļticību Latgalē, mazākumtautību integrāciju, mākslu, Latgales īpašajām tradīcijām, svētkiem, arheoloģiju Latgalē. Raidījumi "Sajūti LATGALI" stāstīs arī par lauksaimniecību un uzņēmīgiem cilvēkiem, kuri ikdienā attīsta Latgales reģionu.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Safety in the sky depends on the outcome of air crash investigations. But sometimes investigators disagree, and the pressure intensifies when the victims are famous. A crash carrying the Manchester United football team sparks an international argument. A storm of controversy ignites when a planeload of US military personnel goes down in a fiery blaze. And, conspiracy theories erupt on both sides when the president of Poland is killed in a crash en route to Russia.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Spatial disorientation is one of the leading causes of all air accidents. Even the most experienced pilots are susceptible to its subtle yet deadly effects. A confused John F. Kennedy Jr. disappears on the way to Martha's Vineyard. High over the Red Sea, a captain loses his bearings and crashes his passenger jet. And, off the coast of Indonesia, pilots fly their Boeing 737 into a violent storm and end up on the ocean floor.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: In the South, coastguards discover a new strategy by traffickers, leaving bundles submerged for extended periods. In Madrid, at the Customs Surveillance Service, they track the signal of a narco-submarine believed to have departed from Colombia with cocaine. Furthermore, jet skis have been detected creating dangerous situations along the Costa Dorada.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: During the Dutch F1 Grand Prix, Amsterdam Central will have to deal with 60,000 racing fanatics. They will depart throughout the morning, but will all come back at the same time. For Traffic Control and the station employees, it is all hands-on deck to manage the enormous flow of people. While people are trying to prevent passenger congestion, the shops are waiting for their delayed goods.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: King's Day is the busiest day of the year at Amsterdam Central Station. While Ticket & Services employee Alexandra, and Station Manager René try to steer the crowds in the right direction, Assistant Manager Michel is busy coordinating the flow of goods due to a broken freight elevator. Meanwhile, officers Menno and Carolien revive a girl who has fallen ill.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Saving Venice
programme.desc: Venice, one of the most iconic cities in the world. Distributed over 118 small islands, it seems to lie in the middle of its lagoon like a sleeping beauty in a magnificent and motionless eternity. But from time to time its sleep is disturbed by the sea's incursions. These are becoming increasingly frequent and violent due the phenomenon of Global Warming and Climate Change. Are these perhaps the first signals of an environmental crisis that will affect the whole planet? Today the city is a kind of open-air laboratory where the greatest experts and the most advanced technologies have rushed to understand what mistakes we have made and what we can still do to save this symbolic city.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: Whether you're trying to get to the head of the class, earn the big promotion, or just find a parking spot - every day, you're competing. With yourself… and with others. So what is it about the human brain that makes you want to win - sometimes at all costs? In this episode we'll explore your brain and competition through a series of, well… competitions! Each viewer will be assigned a team and play along as our Red and Blue teams duke it out in a head to head battle to determine the winner of "The Brain Games" . Along the way you'll learn what drives you to compete, why some people may be born more competitive, and how a little healthy rivalry can help you climb the ladder of success. You've got to be in it to win it on Brian Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: In this episode youll play along with interactive games that unlock the secrets to attraction, youll learn how your brain quickly calculates whats attractive (or not), and youll discover how hidden formulas can predict whom you consider beautiful. Youll journey into the secrets of long-term relationships, and youll play along and discover just what it is that attracts two people together beyond conscious control including a shocking revelation of the one body part that can often predict compatibility. From secret formulas to brainwave patterns, youll see the mysteries of attraction revealed. Prepare to discover that beauty isnt skin deep its brain deep on Brain Games.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: This is a show about your brain and stress. Youll see how your brain manages stress and how stress also manages you. From traffic jams to screaming babies, angry bosses to bill payments, youre surrounded by stress everyday. But stress has a purpose, and youll discover why its a good thing in many situations, even though it can overwhelm you. But dont let that stress you outthere are ways to manage it! Through a series of interactive games and experiments,youll discover how stress works and how to handle it better. So sit back, relax and dont stress out…on Brain Games.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Crashes involving high-profile passengers make international headlines and, placing investigators under tremendous pressure to come up with answers as the world looks on. A diplomat's secret mission ends with a mystery that lingers for decades. Tragedy strikes when pilots gamble with the lives of a famous Brazilian football team. And, a US Air Force jet carrying an American VIP crashes in war-torn Croatia.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: Maritime mysteries -- old and new -- come to life in this 10-episode series, combining scientific data and digital re-creations to reveal shipwrecks, treasures, and sunken cities on the bottom of lakes, seas and oceans around the world. Innovative technology allows viewers to see what lies on the floors of large bodies of water such as the Gulf of Mexico, the Nile, the Indian Ocean, the Baltic Sea and the Atlantic Ocean as if they had been drained. Then, in a quest to explain natural wonders and man-made catastrophes, stories tell of how vessels sank, what ancient geological formations reveal about life on Earth, where Nazi secrets now reside, and why so many continue to search for the legendary city of Atlantis.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: Maritime mysteries -- old and new -- come to life in this 10-episode series, combining scientific data and digital re-creations to reveal shipwrecks, treasures, and sunken cities on the bottom of lakes, seas and oceans around the world. Innovative technology allows viewers to see what lies on the floors of large bodies of water such as the Gulf of Mexico, the Nile, the Indian Ocean, the Baltic Sea and the Atlantic Ocean as if they had been drained. Then, in a quest to explain natural wonders and man-made catastrophes, stories tell of how vessels sank, what ancient geological formations reveal about life on Earth, where Nazi secrets now reside, and why so many continue to search for the legendary city of Atlantis.

programme.title: Atlantis Rising
programme.desc: Executive Produced by James Cameron, "Atlantis Discovered" is a 1x120 detective thriller that seeks out, uncovers and explores artifacts such as archaeological finds, satellite photographs, manuscripts hiding in plain sight, underwater exploration, etc. and attempt to "decode" the artifacts as springboards to further the investigation to get to the bottom of the story.

programme.title: Lost Cities with Albert Lin: The Great Flood
programme.desc: Albert Lin is in search of the origins of the Great Flood. A story that is not just an echo from our ancient past but shared by cultures across the world. It's an epic quest that takes Albert from the icy depths of the Black Sea and the remains of a lost prehistoric civilization to the heights of the Peruvian Andes and a sacrifice site like no other.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur.

programme.title: Megastructures
programme.desc: Exciting documentary series that shows viewers some extreme and extraordinary construction projects- the biggest, tallest, longest or deepest in the world, and the machines that are used to create such amazing structures. The series features interviews with designers and project managers, who present the problems of construction and the methodology or techniques used to overcome obstacles. Some ''megastructures'' included in the series are US Navy's aircraft carrier, the USS Ronald Reagan, highway with no speed limit built in Germany, undersea tunnel built between France and United Kingdom, world's longest suspension bridge in Japan, twin tower skyscraper in Kuala Lumpur, etc.

programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: On the Mediterranean coast of Turkiye, the Sanmar Shipyards is quietly reshaping the future of global shipping. As container ships grow larger and ports become more congested, tugboats have become essential to keeping world trade moving. Led by second-generation owner Ali Gurun, Sanmar builds powerful tugboats at scale while working closely with a Vancouver-based naval architecture firm to design the next generation of vessels. Pound for pound, tugboats are the strongest vessels at sea, built to push and pull ships many times their size. Now the team must prove that electric power can deliver the same precision and muscle as diesel when maneuvering a 264-meter container ship weighing 54000 tonnes through tight harbor waters, where there is no margin for error.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: In 1981, the Federal Aviation Administration established the sterile cockpit rule requiring pilots to refrain from non-essential activities during critical phases of flight. When this rule is broken, the resulting distraction can be deadly. Passengers fight for their lives inside a burning plane at Dallas Fort Worth Airport. A brand new L-1011 crashes in a remote swamp in the Florida Everglades. And, during a demonstration flight, a brand new Russian Superjet slams into a mountain south of Jakarta.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: One of aviation's worst nightmares, a fire on board can have disastrous consequences. And though these epic tragedies have exacted a terrible human cost, they've also helped lead the way towards significantly safer skies. In Manchester, a holiday flight bound for the Mediterranean faces an inferno on the runway. In the skies over Saudi Arabia, a flight ful of pilgrims is consumed by flames. And, after a UPS cargo plane crashes in Dubai, investigators discover a tiny battery with outsize implications.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: King Herod is reviled as one of the most evil characters in the Bible, responsible for the horrific "massacre of the innocents" in his efforts to kill the infant Jesus Christ. But later historians coin him "Herod the Great." Now, immersive CGI and new archaeological discoveries—on land and deep underwater—reveal the truth about this Biblical villain.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: The Bible's famous Tower of Babel, so tall it reached the heavens, exceeded all modern engineering wonders. We follow a season of excavations to discover if such a tower ever existed. Teams dig deep to reveal magnificent ancient monuments across Iraq and take to the skies to search Babylon for answers. New discoveries and immersive CGI shed light on the world in which this Bible story was written.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: Every year, flood risks increase. Across the globe, big cities are experiencing giant storm surges and extreme rainfall, overwhelming natural waterways and drainage systems, catastrophes that rewrite the rules for engineers. In Tokyo, a city already prone to natural disasters, giant rivers are being built underground to cope with raging torrents and typhoons. In Spain, the horror of the Valencia floods has taught authorities the importance of early warning systems when infrastructure fails. In New Orleans, the Army Corps has revolutionized storm surge barriers — but it took the worst flood tragedy in US history to rewrite the future.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: When the Morandi Bridge collapsed in Genova in 2018, it was more than a national tragedy. Its failure was a reckoning for engineers everywhere and a sobering reminder that every structure has a lifespan. In a world of increasing populations, changing traffic volumes and extreme weather events, how can we safeguard new bridges? Engineers for Genova's new bridge met the challenge, focusing on intelligent safety and advanced robotics. As Turkey builds the longest suspension bridge in the world, engineers push the limits with clever innovations, delivering a modern marvel that withstands wild winds, catastrophic ship collisions and Earth's seismic fury.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Disasters can strike anywhere, anytime. To find out why, expert analysis of the available evidence is used to recreate real world disasters in cutting edge 3D graphics. We can dissect them, peel back the layers, even freeze time to reveal a disaster's hidden and surprising causes – a paperwork error, a bad glue job, changing a restaurant opening hours. Whatever it is, Disaster Autopsy will uncover it.

programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: "Mega Marine Machines" brings viewers inside the most demanding marine operations on the planet, where powerful machines and skilled crews are pushed to their limits. Across oceans, rivers and working coastlines, each episode follows professionals using science, engineering and advanced technology to solve real-world problems on the water. With rare access to ships, shipyards and marine environments, the series reveals how critical decisions are made under pressure. As challenges unfold, the science behind the machines becomes clear, delivering meaningful insights through action-driven storytelling. The result is a forward-looking exploration of how humans are building, operating and innovating on the oceans and waterways of a changing world.

Teams dig deep to reveal magnificent ancient monuments across Iraq and take to the skies to search Babylon for answers. New discoveries and immersive CGI shed light on the world in which this Bible story was written.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: In 1981, the Federal Aviation Administration established the sterile cockpit rule requiring pilots to refrain from non-essential activities during critical phases of flight. When this rule is broken, the resulting distraction can be deadly. Passengers fight for their lives inside a burning plane at Dallas Fort Worth Airport. A brand new L-1011 crashes in a remote swamp in the Florida Everglades. And, during a demonstration flight, a brand new Russian Superjet slams into a mountain south of Jakarta.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: One of aviation's worst nightmares, a fire on board can have disastrous consequences. And though these epic tragedies have exacted a terrible human cost, they've also helped lead the way towards significantly safer skies. In Manchester, a holiday flight bound for the Mediterranean faces an inferno on the runway. In the skies over Saudi Arabia, a flight ful of pilgrims is consumed by flames. And, after a UPS cargo plane crashes in Dubai, investigators discover a tiny battery with outsize implications.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Mariana tackles what one of her sources calls "the untouchable smuggling story." The black market for tigers and tiger parts is so lucrative, so secretive and so dangerous that few have attempted to uncover its ugly details. Mariana journeys far, and near, to meet the smugglers face-to-face.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: While Menno and Carolien have their hands full with an aggressive fare dodger, the incident response team searches for three illegal rail runners. This all happens the same day the Orient Express arrives to the station and Errol, the night conductor, has to deal with a train full of people coming from a concert.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Amsterdam Central is undergoing a mega renovation while the station remains fully operational. Today, the construction team, led by Leon, will demolish a dilapidated railway bridge. Meanwhile, officers Menno and Carolien deal with a woman who has fallen down an escalator.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Ice Rroad Rescue
programme.desc: A tanker truck full of waste slides back on a narrow, icy hill, almost slamming into a snow-covered car. It's a tight spot, forcing Thord to use his lightweight pick-up - but one slip risks turning this rescue into a disaster. In Overhalla, tow-trucker Marius stops by Jo Roger's garage on a road trip south. But when the visit gets interrupted by an emergency call, Jo Roger invites Marius to join the rescue. What was a ten-minute coffee break turns into a hard night's work.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: Using the latest sonar technology, a unique expedition to map sunken Allied vessels off the Normandy Coast reveals stunning images from beneath the waves. There are over a hundred shipwrecks in the English Channel of the landing craft and ships that took part in the greatest amphibious Invasion Fleet ever assembled. As the water drains away, we reveal extraordinary, secret technology deployed by both the Allies and the Nazis in the battle for western Europe. The outcome of that conflict changes our world forever.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: For over fifty years the world's two greatest superpowers, the United States and Soviet Union, pour their resources into a terrifying array of doomsday weapons and military machines. The Cold War is the world's first nuclear armed confrontation. Remarkably, it's also the greatest clandestine war in the history of mankind - conducted in secret beneath the waves. Now, with access to daring expeditions, precision data and classified information, we use ground-breaking computer-generated-images to drain the ocean and reveal the shocking secrets of the nuclear-armed Cold War.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: Draining the ocean near Newfoundland reveals a preserved Basque galleon trading in lucrative whale oil. The Spanish empire relies on powerful ships like this to bring back valuable cargo, like silver and tobacco, from the New World. But when emerging rival England wants a share of this wealth, the Spanish attack. Draining an Armada wreck off the coast of Ireland reveals an extraordinary battle for control.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: In February 1998 a US Marine Corps prowler jet took off for a routine training mission through the Italian Alps. On the final leg of its flight the aircraft's right wing sliced through the supporting cable of a ski gondola filled with tourists. The gondola plummeted over 100m to the valley floor and all 20 passengers perished. The prowler jet was severely damaged but the pilot made it back the 90kilometres to their base. Seconds from Disaster investigates the causes and repercussions of the crash and speaks exclusively with a member of the aircrew who, alongside the investigators and victims' families, are all still haunted by this tragedy.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: October 5th 1999, a passenger train leaving London Paddington during the morning rush hour collides with an incoming train at a combined speed of 209 kph. The impact, and an unprecedented 20-meter high fireball, that sweeps over the mangled carriages, kills 29 passengers and both drivers, and leaves hundreds injured and trapped in the twisted wreckage. The original lead investigators recreate their analysis of how two trains came to be travelling towards each other on the same stretch of track, and why automatic warning systems and fully functioning brakes were not enough to prevent one of the worst rail accidents in British history. Step by step reconstruction of the circumstances reveals a startling history of near misses that should have made one of the worst rail accidents in British history avoidable.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: Amid civil war in 14th century Mongol-controlled China, scholar and strategist Liu Bowen lends his talents to a dynasty on the rise. But his name is also remembered for a more mysterious talent: fortune-telling with what some say is frightening precision. A series of cryptic prophecies earns him the moniker of China's "Nostradamus." In Ancient Rome, Julius Caesar receives a warning that his life is in danger. The prophecy, uttered by an Etruscan soothsayer, is divined through the strange art of haruspicy. Caesar ignores the omen at his own peril. Amongst the hills of the Scottish Lowlands, the influential Erskine family becomes haunted by a mysterious prophecy, presaging and inflicting countless moments of tragedy and heartbreak.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: Edgar Cayce, known as the "sleeping prophet," claims to use hypnotic states to heal the sick and see the future. Cayce is alleged to have predicted the Wall Street Crash of 1929, the Second World War, and the assassination of JFK. His aura stokes fear around his most frightening prediction of all — the end of the world. In Ancient Greece, the Oracle of Delphi is the premier prophesier of the ancient world. The words of this Pythia, channeled down from Apollo, go on to shape human history, foretelling the rise and fall of empires. And in 19th-century France, radical occult thinker Eliphas Lévi draws upon early mysticism to develop a spiritual doctrine. Branded as a devil worshiper by the public, the truth of his life's work is even stranger.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Security officials at El Dorado International Airport, in Bogota, Colombia, continue to foil the most audacious attempts at drug trafficking. On this new season of Airport Alert, they must detect sophisiticated new drug smuggling methods, arrest luggage thieves and detain suspects with international arrest warrants, while also dealing with medical emergencies, document forgery and cases of identity theft. Ranked as one of the 23 best airpots in the world, El Dorado is one of the biggest and most dynamic air terminals in Latin America. The airport serves 25 million passengers and handles 200,000 tons of cargo every year in its 1,100-hectare facility. Things are moving day and night, and appearances can be deceiving. Airport Alert follows agents 24/7 and captures their efforts to ensure the security of passengers and cargo alike.

programme.title: Narco State: Aftermath
programme.desc: In 2009, Ciudad Juárez, Mexico, was called murder capital. Phoenix, USA, was experiencing a rise in kidnappings. More than ten years later, we return to these cities to explore how the smuggling of guns, drugs, money and people connect the U.S. and Mexico in ways that go beyond their shared border.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Flying over the Himalayan foothills on a short hop from the Nepali capital Kathmandu to the tourist city of Pokhara, Yeti Airlines Flight 691 is cleared to land. And while a passenger live streams the final approach—and just seconds from the runway—the plane stalls and crashes into a gorge. Destroyed on impact, investigators find a scene of utter annihilation at the crash site. Eyewitness video gives them their first lead—the aircraft came in at a severe left bank. And the wreckage indicates the engines were in the feathered position, and therefore unable to provide thrust. A deep dive soon proves their was nothing wrong with the plane. And when investigators listen to the CVR, they're stunned to uncover overloaded pilots and a fatal case of mistaken identity.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. Unraveling the complex mystery is a painstaking process that takes months—and sometimes years—of detective work. The twisted wreckage at the crash site tells part of the story; investigators can use it to learn about the final seconds of a flight and rule out mechanical failures. The flight data and cockpit voice recorders are critical, but they don't always reveal what happened. It almost always takes a tragic combination of factors to bring down an airplane.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: When cases run cold, police in 1970s U.S. call upon the services of Dorothy Allison — the most celebrated "psychic detective" of her time. From the kidnapping of Patty Hearst to the crimes of Son of Sam, Allison sometimes provides incredible insights. In the 2010s, John of God is a leading light of the New Age movement with celebrity followers. He calls himself a psychic healer, but those closest to the man know that the truth is darker than anyone can imagine. In the first century C.E., Jewish commander Josephus is captured by the Romans. Apparently using ancient prophecy for political ends, he tells his captor, Roman General Vespasian, that he is prophesied to rule the world. The consequences have far-reaching effects on human history.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Peru's biggest airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest problem: cocaine smuggling. The clothes in a 19-year-old's bag are oddly damp - they're soaked in liquid cocaine. Police uncover a 16 kg load in a suitcase. Officers detain two Colombians headed to Mexico. They've travelled from the Amazon - and they may be carrying. In the mail facility, cocaine is found infused in a blanket and hidden in artisanal boxes.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: The best stories from El Dorado, Colombia's biggest airport, where law enforcement must stay on top to fight the criminal organizations who use the most diverse methods to move their product like hiding drugs in wine and shampoo. The full scope of the human drama comes to life when a man confesses that he is trying to pay debts after his children died, and a woman asks her mother for forgiveness ina heart-wrenching telephone call.

programme.title: Airport Security: Brazil
programme.desc: Federal Police at Sao Paolo International Airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. Their main threat, cocaine smuggling. Agents arrest two different traffickers with bricks of cocaine branded in the same curious way. One of those loads is among the largest of the last few years. Panicked asylum seekers refuse to cooperate, causing an uproar. And suitcases carrying hundreds of counterfeit goods are intercepted.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Air and Marine Operations in St. Thomas arrest a suspected smuggler and chase a vessel fleeing into British Virgin Island waters. U.S. Customs and Border Protection busts a mother-daughter duo smuggling large amounts of marijuana through Miami International Airport to the Caribbean. In El Paso, alerts from the K9 at the Sierra Blanca checkpoint lead U.S. Border Patrol agents to the discovery of drugs and guns in multiple vehicles.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: U.S. Coast Guard, Air and Marine Operations, and Homeland Security Investigations join forces in Florida to target a suspected human smuggling ring. In Texas, U.S. Customs and Border Protection inspects a truck loaded with construction materials and uncovers a cunningly concealed cache of cocaine - almost 200 kilos hidden in rolls of plastic. And at Newark International Airport, a rookie CBP officer is eager to undertake her first drug bust, though the substance in question is not quite what she expected.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: In 16th-century France, astrologer Nostradamus wrote hundreds of cryptic verses implying impossible knowledge of future events, including the French Revolution, the Second World War, the assassination of JFK, and the attacks of Sept. 11, 2001. Who was Nostradamus, and what did he say? In Central Europe, local legends say Houska Castle guards a portal to hell and is the site of dark, storied history. Here, young poet Karel Hynek Macha had a feverish dream of a future that terrified him. In medieval Italy, St. Francis of Assisi was subjected to the world's first case of stigmata, receiving the wounds of the Christian messiah on his hands, feet and torso. Are the stigmata a blessing, a curse, or a traditional blend of legend and truth? Final

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Mariana van Zeller uncovers one of the world's most notorious smuggling routes from it's origin in the remote Peruvian jungle, to Colombia's Caribbean coast, all the way to the streets of Miami. Along the way, she learns how both the smugglers and the enforcers risk their lives while operating along the 4 decade old pipeline that's producing more cocaine not seen since the 1980s, despite the crackdown of the US War on drugs.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Follow the dedicated teams working tirelessly 24/7 at Amsterdam Central Station, where managing over 1,500 trains and 180,000 passengers daily is no easy feat—especially during Pride Day. When a train loses power, it's a race against time for traffic control and emergency responders. Adding to the challenge, the station is undergoing the largest renovation in its history, all while keeping to a full schedule.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: The station is undergoing an impressive transformation, with the old railway bridge being replaced by a gigantic steel structure. Superintendent Leon faces a huge challenge in this complex operation. Security & Services staff accompany two undocumented migrants to the Asylum Seekers Application Centre, while Gusta helps travelers recover lost property in the Lost & Found department.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Thord tries to tow out a car that crashed sixty metres into a field after a snowstorm, but gets stressed when a winch failure threatens the rescue. In the north, a truck driver avoids a head-on collision by steering his truck and trailer off the road, into hard packed snow. Raido takes charge of the rescue, but whatever he does its never enough. Six hours in, the truck stays stuck, and the rookie must dig deep to turn this mission around.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: Nature's vicious battles for survival come at every scale, from 6 ton Elephants, fighting in a testosterone fuelled blind fury, to slime covered inch and half long amphibian kick boxers, dangling in the jaws of death. This is a no-holds barred look at cold-hearted killers in the wild, revealing ambush experts with piercing canines, slithering assassins with crushing coils, and multi-layered fangs dealing death, in Animal Fight Club.

programme.title: When Sharks Attack... And Why
programme.desc: Two coastal beach communities in Charleston, South Carolina, and the French territory of New Caledonia experience an unprecedented surge in shark attacks. Located halfway around the world from each other, these two locales shared one terrifying commonality: both were virtually untouched by aggressive shark behavior before this uptick in incidents. A combined 10 attacks and two fatalities leave the communities scrambling to investigate the cause. In the Pacific paradise of New Caledonia, scientists theorize a rogue tiger shark on the hunt, and on the genteel Atlantic coast of Charleston, investigators look to a new species of hammerhead sharks for an answer.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: On the African Plains, the American Highlands, and the Desert Badlands, Animal Fight Night exposes nature, red in tooth and claw. Lions go head to head, a Grey Wolf pack takes on a Grizzly, Hippos hammer out a violent battle, and one of the world's largest monkeys plans a mission to murder. Lust, Jealousy, and Pure Rage fuel deadly encounters in the wild, as the natural world shows its savage side.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a land of extremes. Many hundred thousand square miles of forests, grasslands and mountains. Existing here is a daunting proposition, and some well-known animals have adapted by growing large or very small, each strategy maximizing their chance of survival.

programme.title: South America's Weirdest Animals
programme.desc: South America is a rich and diverse land. Stunning landscapes harbor elusive critters that have evolved to thrive here. But survival is not assured because the abundant prey is closely followed by powerful predators. From giant killer dolphins to the largest cat in the Americas, this vast continent is a lethal predator battleground.

programme.title: South Africa: Cradle of Killers
programme.desc: From strange chance encounters to aggressive territorial disputes, only South Africa's fittest - or luckiest - will survive to live another day.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: "Animal Fight Club: Power Struggles" reveals how the even the most epic battles can be won or lost in a split second. In the world of wild animal fights, nothing is ever certain. Whether an animal is fighting for food, shelter or for survival itself, there are no guarantees. Sometimes even strength of numbers is not enough. In this episode we see a female leopard fight a bigger male for her lunch and her life, discover the complex competition amongst the world's largest Great Apes and see how a Nile Monitor Lizard can turn its tail into a show stopping weapon.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: Sri Lanka: Leopard Dynasty
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. Sri Lanka's lowlands are home to one of the highest leopard populations on earth. It's in these lowland jungles the Sri Lankan Leopard - the apex predator of the country - resides.

programme.title: Desert Lions: Surviving At Skeleton Coast
programme.desc: In this true story, lion researcher Dr. Philip Stander follows three orphaned lion cubs from birth to adulthood as they navigate the complexity of survival in one of the world's most unforgiving environments, Namibia's deadly Skeleton Coast. He gets up close and personal to unlock secrets of their world and witness the amazing adaptability of these special cats.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programme.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu Game Reserve, one of the last sanctuaries for free-roaming leopards, a mother gives birth to two cubs. She'll stop at nothing to protect them. But as climate change tightens its grip, resources dwindle, and a fierce leopard war looms. Over three years of intimate observation, this film unveils rare, breathtaking footage of behaviors never before documented, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the resilience and secrets of this elusive species.

programme.title: Super Pride
programme.desc: The Serengeti, in northern Tanzania, teems with big predators. But none compare to the lion. The Serengeti sustains one of the biggest lion populations in Africa: approximately 3,500 lions in 300 prides. But this pride, residing in the central Serengeti, is an exception. 22 lions in all: they are a Super Pride.

programme.title: Tree Climbing Lions
programme.desc: Big cat biologist Alexander Braczkowski is on a mission. He's got 90 days to count lions in Uganda and learn how the population is doing. But these aren't ordinary lions. The prides in Queen Elizabeth National Park spend most of their lives up in the trees, a rare and mysterious behavior unique to this part of Africa.

programme.title: Night Stalkers
programme.desc: Through the use of specially developed night vision cameras, this revelatory episode exposes the real nature and behavior of the Sri Lankan leopard. In Yala National Park on the small island of Sri Lanka lives one of the highest leopard populations in the world. Using unique equipment in the complete darkness of the Sri Lankan jungle, follow these secretive solitary creatures as they prowl in surprisingly social lives.

programme.title: Return of the Clouded Leopards
programme.desc: This special follows the work of wildlife Photographer Sandesh Kadur and Wild Life Trust of India Vet Dr Bhaskar Choudhury, as they undergo the unique rehabilitation of 2 orphaned Clouded Leopard cubs to their natural jungle habitat. The 2 cubs are hand reared, and taught to live independently before being released back to the jungle. A year on the, team unite to search for the cubs they set free more than a year ago.

programme.title: Snow Leopard of Afghanistan
programme.desc: Scientists try to catch and notice one of the most beautiful big cats. However they must go to war zones for that.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol

programme.title: Night Stalkers
programme.desc: Through the use of specially developed night vision cameras, this revelatory episode exposes the real nature and behavior of the Sri Lankan leopard. In Yala National Park on the small island of Sri Lanka lives one of the highest leopard populations in the world. Using unique equipment in the complete darkness of the Sri Lankan jungle, follow these secretive solitary creatures as they prowl in surprisingly social lives.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programme.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu Game Reserve, one of the last sanctuaries for free-roaming leopards, a mother gives birth to two cubs. She'll stop at nothing to protect them. But as climate change tightens its grip, resources dwindle, and a fierce leopard war looms. Over three years of intimate observation, this film unveils rare, breathtaking footage of behaviors never before documented, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the resilience and secrets of this elusive species.

programme.title: Desert Lions: Surviving At Skeleton Coast
programme.desc: In this true story, lion researcher Dr. Philip Stander follows three orphaned lion cubs from birth to adulthood as they navigate the complexity of survival in one of the world's most unforgiving environments, Namibia's deadly Skeleton Coast. He gets up close and personal to unlock secrets of their world and witness the amazing adaptability of these special cats.

programme.title: Super Pride
programme.desc: The Serengeti, in northern Tanzania, teems with big predators. But none compare to the lion. The Serengeti sustains one of the biggest lion populations in Africa: approximately 3,500 lions in 300 prides. But this pride, residing in the central Serengeti, is an exception. 22 lions in all: they are a Super Pride.

programme.title: Tree Climbing Lions
programme.desc: Big cat biologist Alexander Braczkowski is on a mission. He's got 90 days to count lions in Uganda and learn how the population is doing. But these aren't ordinary lions. The prides in Queen Elizabeth National Park spend most of their lives up in the trees, a rare and mysterious behavior unique to this part of Africa.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: A central theme of this episode is the remarkable learning behavior of orcas, passed on from generation to generation. As marine biologist and wildlife filmmaker Florian Graner explores the mysteries of orcas, viewers immerse themselves in the different cultures of the orca populations in the Salish Sea. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends the documentary a special depth with her narration and takes viewers on a journey into the world of the largest members of the dolphin family. The documentary sheds light on the fascinating world of the black-and-white giants of the seas, their intelligence, complex social structures, and their impressive ability to pass on knowledge from generation to generation.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 2 sets the scene, now the zebras wander off, a striped echo of part one. If the first episode is dusted in browns and yellows, this is green as the landscape changes and the rain turn again, rising rivers, making it difficult for everyone again, flooding, rushing waters in a raging torrent. Paradise it may be, but it is a harsh paradise. As the rains clear, we catch up with another character introduced in the first episode, our serval mother that had her den flooded; but she reveals that she has survived. And so has her cub - a miracle under these circumstances.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Geniuses
programme.desc: Africa, with its diverse ecosystems from arid deserts to lush forests, is home to some remarkable wild geniuses. While these outliers may not be the strongest, they compensate with their wit. They deploy adaptive strategies and surprising maneuvers to survive against all odds. In the desert, meerkats teach their young to communicate while the caracal uses adaptations to hunt elusive prey, and the wheel spider uses its engineering skills to ride the dunes. In the savannah, the secretarybird cares for her chicks; the dung beetle navigates obstacles; and the Thomson's gazelle relies on keen instinct. In the Highlands, gelada monkeys choose leaders to maintain social order, and the Ethiopian wolf uses clever tricks to feed her cubs. In the forest, the aye-aye and chameleon use their supernatural skills to forage the forest.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: Big cats may seem like the ultimate wildlife cliche, but they're locked in a global battle for survival. Powerful and dangerous, they now clash with humans more than ever. This sweeping safari reveals their resilience and adaptability. Cheetahs hunt from cars, jaguars stalk prey underwater and around boats, and India's lions prowl city streets. Familiar species and behaviors take on new drama, with revelations that reaffirm why big cats remain nature's most formidable predators.

programme.title: Cat Attack-Tics
programme.desc: Explore the many ways wild cats go in for the kill. Cats rarely seen in action, such as the marbled cat, the fishing cat and the sand cat, will all be featured in Cat Attack-tics. Classic Nat Geo footage is mixed with high-tech graphics, freeze frames and photo finishes to magnify the killer weaponry.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: Orcas are the rulers of the seas. These majestic marine mammals have captured the hearts of people with their intelligence and complex family structures. However, since killer whales started attacking boats near Gibraltar, many are asking: Are they threatening us or just playing? The central revelation is that orcas, with specialized "cultures," perfectly exploit the richness of the seas. Surprisingly, there are different orca cultures around the globe. This episode also showcases impressive images of how the curious whales create genuine "fashions," and meet for mating. Their family groups are led by experienced matriarchs who maintain lifelong bonds with their offspring, particularly their sons. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends her voice to the documentary, giving the orcas' stories a special depth.

programme.title: Madagascar's Weirdest Compilation
programme.desc: Madagascar is an island nation set adrift for millions of years, leaving its wildlife in extreme isolation and causing some bizarre adaptations. Many of the creatures here are found nowhere else on earth. From the feared fossa to the mysterious aye-aye, and a variety of lemurs, in Madagascar, being weird is a way of life.

programme.title: Borneo's Secret Kingdom: Weird And Wild
programme.desc: Flowing from the heart of Borneo, the Kinabatangan River is a cornucopia of life. From deep within mountains, to its ultimate meeting with the sea. Borneo stands at a triple junction of three tectonic plates, and at the crossroads of two oceans. The river is home to 50 mammal species, 200 types of bird, and countless insects. Fuelled by yearly monsoons, at its headwaters, mountains have sustained wet tropical forests. In the floodplains below, strange and more unexpected life inhabits the dense jungle. Beyond lie tangled mangroves nursing the next generation of marine creatures. Finally, at the cusp of the Sulu Sea the journey begins again. In the tropical warmth, moisture evaporates, rises to form clouds, and on mountain ranges rain falls again.
